title_sq: 2 Apartament 1+1 ne shitje 21 Dhjetori ne Tirane
description_sq:

title_en: 2 Apartment 1+1 for sale December 21 in Tirana
description_en: At the intersection of 21 December, near the Diamond Dental clinic, 2 1+1 apartments with a surface area of ​​65 m2 are for sale, on the 5th floor of the existing building. They are organized by distribution corridor, living room, bedroom, toilet and balcony. The apartments have been completely restored from scratch, starting with electrical, plumbing, doors, windows, flooring, etc. It has proper mortgage documentation. Ideal for air bnb.
